questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code validates the loaded configuration values? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The environment has BOOKING_MAX_PASSENGERS=abc and BOOKING_HOLD_TTL=30s. What does Load return?
choices: A zero Config and a single error about BOOKING_MAX_PASSENGERS, since parsing stops at the first failure
A usable Config using the default passenger limit and a nil error, because parse failures fall back to defaults
A non-nil error that reports both the unparsable passenger count and the out-of-range hold TTL
Only an error about the hold TTL, because the failed Atoi leaves a valid default in place

questions.prompt: A deployment template renders BOOKING_INVENTORY_URL as an empty string (the variable is set but empty). What happens at startup?
choices: The default inventory URL is used, since an empty value counts as unset
The service starts and every search fails with a bad gateway
Load returns an error because the empty URL has no host, and main exits via log.Fatalf
Load panics when url.Parse is called on an empty string

questions.prompt: A deployment sets BOOKING_CURRENCY=usd. What does the service do with it?
choices: Rejects it because currency codes must be upper case
Accepts it unchanged and sends currency=usd to the inventory service
Normalizes it to USD before use
Falls back to the default USD because the value does not match the default exactly
